co.del_flag = '0' and co.semester_id = #{semesterId} and co.course_id = #{courseId} and co.offering_status = #{offeringStatus} and co.status = #{status} and cl.course_name like concat('%', #{courseName}, '%')
order by co.offering_id asc

select teacher_id from brm_teacher where status = '0' and dept_id = #{deptId} order by teacher_id
